issue.title: Maestro edge flows: reauth, legal, mic/notification deny
issue.body:
## Summary / context

Parent: #488.

Edge and negative paths that round out regression coverage beyond happy-path smokes: reauth, legal pages, mic deny, notification deny.

## Current vs expected

**Current:** Manual / ad hoc. Some ids already exist (`reauth-banner`, legal links, permission helpers).

**Expected:** Maestro flows (or tagged suite entries) for:
- Reauth banner → password → return
- Privacy / Terms from login and drawer
- Mic deny on Record (assert gated UI, no crash)
- Notification permission deny still allows upload path (assert no crash / sync still usable — match product behavior)

## Scope

**In scope**
- Flows listed above
- Document how to force reauth in **dev** (or skip with N/A if not automatable without backend hooks)

**Out of scope**
- Exhaustive permission matrix on every OEM
- Accessibility audit

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Legal navigation asserts by id
- [ ] Mic-deny flow does not crash; Record remains gated
- [ ] Notification-deny path documented + asserted at smoke level
- [ ] Reauth covered **or** residual documented with reason

## Verification / test plan

1. Run edge suite after auth smokes exist
2. Note device/API limitations in PR

## Links

- Refs #488
